分析（1）等式左、右两边的行列式分别是矩阵 $AB$ 与 $BA$ 的特征多项式，因此，可从矩阵相似的角度去思考；

(2) 用 (1) 的结论来计算 $D_{n}$ 就较为简单了.

解（1）构造 $m + n$ 阶矩阵 $\begin{pmatrix} AB & 0 \\ B & 0 \end{pmatrix}$ 与 $\begin{pmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ B & BA \end{pmatrix}$ ，易见这两个矩阵是相似的，这是因为

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {m} & - A \\ 0 & I _ {n} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} A B & 0 \\ B & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {m} & - A \\ 0 & I _ {n} \end{array} \right) ^ {- 1} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {m} & - A \\ 0 & I _ {n} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} A B & 0 \\ B & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {m} & A \\ 0 & I _ {n} \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 0 \\ B & B A \end{array} \right),
$$

所以它们有相同的特征多项式

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} \lambda I _ {m} - A B & 0 \\ - B & \lambda I _ {n} \end{array} \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c} \lambda I _ {m} & 0 \\ - B & \lambda I _ {n} - B A \end{array} \right|,
$$

即

$$
\left| \lambda I _ {m} - A B \right| \left| \lambda I _ {n} \right| = \left| \lambda I _ {m} \right| \left| \lambda I _ {n} - B A \right|.
$$

由此得到

$$
\left| \lambda I _ {m} - A B \right| = \lambda^ {m - n} \left| \lambda I _ {n} - B A \right|.
$$

(2) 用 (1) 的结论来计算 $D_{n}$ 就较为简单了.

解（1）构造 $m + n$ 阶矩阵 $\begin{pmatrix} AB & 0 \\ B & 0 \end{pmatrix}$ 与 $\begin{pmatrix} 0 & 0 \\ B & BA \end{pmatrix}$ ，易见这两个矩阵是相似的，这是因为

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {m} & - A \\ 0 & I _ {n} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} A B & 0 \\ B & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {m} & - A \\ 0 & I _ {n} \end{array} \right) ^ {- 1} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {m} & - A \\ 0 & I _ {n} \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} A B & 0 \\ B & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {m} & A \\ 0 & I _ {n} \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 0 \\ B & B A \end{array} \right),
$$

所以它们有相同的特征多项式

$$
\left| \begin{array}{c c} \lambda I _ {m} - A B & 0 \\ - B & \lambda I _ {n} \end{array} \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c} \lambda I _ {m} & 0 \\ - B & \lambda I _ {n} - B A \end{array} \right|,
$$

即

$$
\left| \lambda I _ {m} - A B \right| \left| \lambda I _ {n} \right| = \left| \lambda I _ {m} \right| \left| \lambda I _ {n} - B A \right|.
$$

由此得到

$$
\left| \lambda I _ {m} - A B \right| = \lambda^ {m - n} \left| \lambda I _ {n} - B A \right|.
$$

(2) 记 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & a_{1} \\ 1 & a_{2} \\ \vdots & \vdots \\ 1 & a_{n} \end{pmatrix}$ ， $B = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 & \cdots & 1 \\ b_{1} & b_{2} & \cdots & b_{n} \end{pmatrix}$ ，则

$$
\boldsymbol {A} \boldsymbol {B} = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} 1 + a _ {1} b _ {1} & 1 + a _ {1} b _ {2} & \dots & 1 + a _ {1} b _ {n} \\ 1 + a _ {2} b _ {1} & 1 + a _ {2} b _ {2} & \dots & 1 + a _ {2} b _ {n} \\ \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 1 + a _ {n} b _ {1} & 1 + a _ {n} b _ {2} & \dots & 1 + a _ {n} b _ {n} \end{array} \right), \quad \boldsymbol {B} \boldsymbol {A} = \left( \begin{array}{c c} n & \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} \\ \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} b _ {i} & \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} b _ {i} \end{array} \right).
$$

利用（1）中的结论，有

$$
\begin{array}{l} D _ {n} = | - I + A B | = (- 1) ^ {n} | I - A B | = (- 1) ^ {n} | I - B A | \\ = (- 1) ^ {n} \left| \begin{array}{c c} 1 - n & - \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} \\ - \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} b _ {i} & 1. - \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} b _ {i} \end{array} \right| = (- 1) ^ {n} \left[ (1 - n) \left(1 - \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i} b _ {i}\right) - \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i}\right) \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} b _ {i}\right) \right]. \end{array}
$$

评注 由等式 $|\lambda I - AB| = \lambda^{m - n}|\lambda I - BA|$ ，可得结论：矩阵 $AB$ 与 $BA$ 有相同的非零特征值.
